description: This file contains the implementation of the jQuery formatCurrency plugin, including functions for formatting numbers as currency, handling regions, and converting formatted currency back to numbers.

methods.name: formatCurrency
methods.description: Formats the number in selected elements as currency based on settings.

methods.name: toNumber
methods.description: Removes formatting and converts the element's content to a numeric value.

methods.name: asNumber
methods.description: Retrieves the element's value as a number, optionally parsing it.
